idea-plugin.name: Layer Icons
idea-plugin.description:
Icons for Java and Spring projects, inspired by the Catppuccin palette.

Classes: a mascote shows what the class is (class, interface, record, enum, annotation or exception), holding a badge that shows its layer, based on the name suffix: Repository, Service, Controller, DTO, Entity/Model, Config/Configuration and Test.

Folders: outlined folders with layer badges (src, resources, controller, service, repository, dto, entity, config, test, exception and more).

Files: Gradle, Maven, Spring configuration, Docker, YAML, SQL, .env, JSON, XML, .properties, .iml, .jar/.war, LICENSE, Markdown, .txt/.log, .bat/.cmd and .gitignore.

Every icon has light and dark theme versions.
